impact_assessment.why: The committed blend-state feature left the console half uncommitted and a bad merge collapsed applyNodeProperties onto its first if-statement, so the browser console cannot reload a saved blend state for editing and the panel was never documented or gated.
impact_assessment.benefits: The console gains complete blend-space authoring (preview, save, reload), the syntax-valid console script passes node --check, and the editor schema docs match the shipped UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: console-only JS, no API or schema change; dependency: existing preview_blend_space and load_state_machine actions; concurrency: none; state: no persisted format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the change additive and inside app.js, index.html and test_web.py, reuse the existing state-machine load action, and run the project 6/6 gate plus node --check.

[1/3] Plan: audit blend-state playback - fix loops wrapping at the representative clip, and crossfades that pop into and out of a blend state because the controller samples the representative clip instead of the blended pose

impact_assessment.why: ADR-202 wired blend spaces into state machines by sampling them after the controller advanced, so the controller owned loop wrapping (representative clip length) and crossfade target poses (representative clip sample). A looping blend state froze after its shortest clip, and crossfading to or from a blend state jumped to the blended pose instead of blending toward it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Blend states now loop like plain states, loop at the longest clip in the space, and crossfade smoothly in both directions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive AnimationController.set_pose_provider plus a public sample path; dependency: AnimationBlend only; concurrency: none; state: no persisted format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Drive the existing controller with a caller-supplied pose provider, keep the no-provider path byte-identical, and pin every fix with a failing-first regression plus the canonical determinism hash.

[1/4] Plan: verified implicit-state-machine audit remediation - fix ComponentRuntime start() failure cleanup, unify the playtest outcome vocabulary, reconcile the console play loop with server state, share the viewport cursor rule, and make setViewMode always run its reset

impact_assessment.why: Implicit state machines were catalogued then re-verified; 6 reported claims were disproved by probe and rejected. The surviving defects are real: a failed component start leaves hooks running, the playtest outcome vocabulary cannot round-trip its own timeout value, the console play loop never stops when the server ends play, and the box-select cursor rule is duplicated with divergent conditions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct lifecycle teardown, a transcript vocabulary agents can round-trip, no runaway client polling, and one cursor rule instead of four.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ComponentRuntime.start and playtest.read_outcome behaviour; dependency: none new; concurrency: console loops; state: no persisted format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first regression per fix, keep the default paths byte-identical, and run the full 6/6 project gate plus the canonical simulate hash.
